p: עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתַב הָרַב הַקָּדוֹשׁ
along the lines of what the holy Rav wrote
hadran is the expression of hadri bi, turning back,
and selika means that it will be removed.
came from the curse of Chavah
through the flaw of the Nachash,
הַרְבָּה אַרְבֶּה אֵלּוּ שְׁנֵי טִיפֵּי דָמִים כּוּלֵּי
“‘I will greatly increase’ — these are two drops of blood, etc.”
And this was the root of the flaw of the Nachash,
for the pleasure of this world;
and from this came the flaw of the bris,
וְעַל יְדֵי פְּגַם זֶה נַעֲשָׂה מָשׁוּךְ
and through this flaw it became drawn;
and from this followed the sin
of the hundred and thirty years of Adam HaRishon
and whoever is circumcised is called a tzaddik
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב כג, א)
“And those who sport with a little girl, etc.,
are like the generation of the Flood”;
that they will return and rectify the flaw of the bris,
and on the contrary, it will be transformed into merits.
And this is hadran, an expression of hadar, splendor and beauty;
that all the tumah of niddah will be removed,
which came from the flaw of the bris.
And the beginning of Torah she'b'al peh
is with the mitzvah of Krias Shema,
for this is the beginning of entry into words of Torah:
accepting the yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven,
just as Hakadosh Baruch Hu began
יֵשׁ לֵב כְּסִיל לִשְׂמֹאלוֹ (קֹהֶלֶת י, ב).
“the heart of a fool to his left” (Koheles 10:2).
And for this Shas concludes with Tinokes
that through rectifying the flaw of the bris,
the tumah will be removed entirely.
